title: Unique Crisp Middle Eastern Tequeños Skewers
description: A briny, crisp, and light Middle Eastern dish featuring pre-fried tequeños, perfect for a low-carb snack or appetizer. This recipe combines the flavors of the Middle East with the crunch of tequeños.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread 2-3 pre-fried tequeños onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, sumac, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture evenly onto the tequeños, making sure they are fully coated.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 10 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley and crumbly feta cheese, if using.
Serve the tequeños skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley and lemon wedges on the side.
Let the skewers cool for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
